    {"edits":[{"find":"a_tem == 8'b0111_0001","replace":"a_tem == 8'b01110011"}],
     "violated_requirement":"Output match should be 1 when shift register equals 8'b0111_0001, but mutant matches 8'b01110011 instead",
     "spec_basis":"Matching Logic: The output match should be asserted (logic 1) whenever the value of the shift register a_tem matches the specific 8-bit pattern 8'b0111_0001"},
     
    {"edits":[{"find":"a_tem <= {a_tem[6:0],a}","replace":"a_tem <= {a,a_tem[7:1]}"}],
     "violated_requirement":"Shift register should shift left with new bit in LSB, but mutant shifts right with new bit in MSB",
     "spec_basis":"Shift Register Behavior: On every positive edge of the clock, the input a should be shifted into the least significant bit (LSB) of the shift register a_tem"},

    {"edits":[{"find":"a_tem == 8'b0111_0001","replace":"a_tem[7:4] == 4'b0111"}],
     "violated_requirement":"Output match should check all 8 bits but mutant only checks upper 4 bits",
     "spec_basis":"Matching Logic: The output match should be asserted when the shift register matches the full 8-bit pattern"},

    {"edits":[{"find":"a_tem == 8'b0111_0001","replace":"a_tem != 8'b0111_0001"}],
     "violated_requirement":"Output match polarity is inverted - asserts when pattern doesn't match",
     "spec_basis":"Matching Logic: match should be 1 when pattern matches, 0 otherwise"}
]}

This will be triggered after shifting in the sequence 01110011.","spec_basis":"The specification requires 'match' to be asserted only when the shift register matches 8'b0111_0001."}]}

{"candidates":[{"edits":[{"find":"a_tem <= {a_tem[6:0],a}","replace":"a_tem <= {a_tem[6:0],~a}"}],"violated_requirement":"When the input 'a' is inverted during shift-in, the shift register accumulates incorrect values, causing the match output to fail when the sequence 8'b0111_0001 is expected.","spec_basis":"Shift register should retain the 8 most recent bits of 'a' as-is."},{"edits":[{"find":"a_tem == 8'b0111_0001","replace":"a_tem == 8'b0111_0001 && match"}],"violated_requirement":"The match output becomes dependent on its previous value, causing it to fail to detect new occurrences of the pattern after the first match.","spec_basis":"Output 'match' should be asserted whenever the shift register matches the specific pattern."},{"edits":[{"find":"match <= 1'b1","replace":"match <= 1'b0"}],"violated_requirement":"The match output is never asserted even when the shift register contains the correct pattern 8'b0111_0001.","spec_basis":"Output 'match' should be asserted when the shift register matches the specific pattern."},{"edits":[{"find":"match <= 1'b0","replace":"match <= 1'b1"}],"violated_requirement":"The match output is always asserted regardless of the shift register contents.","spec_basis":"Output 'match' should only be asserted when the shift register matches the specific pattern."}]}
